70: ## Editing constraints
71: 
72: Freshly read existing edit targets in the current run; old messages/handoff are
73: navigation, not current read evidence. `edit_file_from_read` edits a stable range;
74: `edit_file` handles small local changes; `mutate_ui_plugin_source` makes one atomic

76: files after stale-content errors. Do not hand-edit `registry.generated.ts`, the

80: slots and original approval/interrupt/error renderers. New user/screen-reader copy
81: uses the unified domain locale namespace with en-US/zh-CN parity; never patch

87: state or Service abstractions. Follow the packaged Plugin API example.

91: Own box-sizing, min-width and responsive maximum size. Flex/grid children must
